question: If you look at a car from the very top (like a bird), what basic shape do you see? 🚗
explanation: Super! When viewed from the top, a car's roof and body look like a long rectangle! 🚗
hint: It looks like a long box.

question: How does a tea cup look when you view it from the top? ☕
explanation: Awesome! The top opening of a cup is perfectly round like a circle! ☕
hint: Think of the shape of a coin.

question: Which view shows the handle of a mug clearly? ☕
explanation: Great job! Looking from the side lets you see the handle sticking out perfectly! 🌟
hint: Look at it from left or right.

question: If you look at a closed math book from above, what shape is it? 📖
explanation: Wonderful! Books have straight edges and look like rectangles from the top! 📖
hint: It has four straight sides.

question: A map helps us find our way. What does it show? 🗺️
explanation: Excellent! A map shows us different places and the paths to reach them! 🗺️
hint: It guides you where to go.

question: You are facing the rising sun. Which direction is this? 🌅
explanation: Super! The sun always rises in the East every morning! 🌅
hint: It is the starting direction of the day.

question: The sun sets in the evening. Which direction is this? 🌇
explanation: Great job! At the end of the day, the sun goes down in the West! 🌇
hint: It is the opposite of East.

question: You are watching cartoons on TV. What view is this? 📺
explanation: Awesome! You sit right in front of the TV to see the screen clearly! 📺
hint: You are looking right at its face.

question: Which view of a long train shows all its windows? 🚂
explanation: Wonderful! From the side, you can see all the windows and doors of the train! 🚂
hint: Look at the longest part.

question: A bird flying high looks down at a house. What does it see? 🐦
explanation: Super! From way up high, the first thing you see is the top roof! 🐦
hint: It is the highest part of the house.

question: You are playing hide and seek behind a big door. Where are you? 🚪
explanation: Great job! Hiding behind something means you are at its back! 🕵️
hint: People cannot see you from the front.

question: Your school is to your right. Which way will you turn? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! If the school is on the right side, you must take a right turn! 🏫
hint: Follow your right hand.

question: The arrow points ⬅️. What does this mean? 🗺️
explanation: Super! This arrow tells us to safely turn to the left side! ⬅️
hint: It points to the left side.

question: How does a perfectly round football look from any side? ⚽
explanation: Great job! A round ball always looks like a circle no matter where you look from! ⚽
hint: It has no corners at all.

question: What does the top view of a standing water bottle look like? 🍼
explanation: Awesome! The cap of the bottle makes it look like a small circle from the top! 🍼
hint: Look at the bottle's cap.

question: A cat is playing under the table. Where is the cat? 🐈
explanation: Wonderful! Being under the table means hiding right below it! 🐈
hint: Look down at the floor.

question: If you look at a round coin from the very top, what shape is it? 🪙
explanation: Super! A coin is flat and perfectly round like a circle! 🪙
hint: It is a round shape.

question: You see a pencil directly from its flat top end. What shape is it? ✏️
explanation: Great job! The flat top end of a round pencil looks just like a tiny circle! ✏️
hint: It is very small and round.

question: What does the side view of a staircase look like? 🪜
explanation: Awesome! From the side, stairs go up and down like a zig-zag line! 🪜
hint: It looks like teeth or steps.

question: If you are facing North, what direction is exactly behind you? 🧭
explanation: Super! South is always exactly in the opposite direction of North! 🧭
hint: It points downwards on a map.

question: You see only the top of a person's hat. What view is this? 🎩
explanation: Great job! Looking down at someone's hat means you are seeing the top view! 🎩
hint: You are looking from above.

question: A pizza box is completely closed. What shape is its top view? 🍕
explanation: Awesome! Even though the pizza is round, the closed box is a big square! 🍕
hint: It has four equal sides.

question: On a reading map, where is the North direction usually placed? 🗺️
explanation: Wonderful! Most maps point the North direction towards the very top! 🗺️
hint: Look up high on the page.

question: What do we call a drawing of a room seen from above? 🏠
explanation: Super! A top-view drawing that shows where things are is called a map! 🗺️
hint: It helps you find things.

question: A friendly dog is standing right next to you. Where is it? 🐕
explanation: Great job! 'Next to' means the dog is standing right by your side! 🐕
hint: It is very close to your hand.

question: If you look at a flat TV from the side, how does it look? 📺
explanation: Awesome! Modern TVs are very flat, so from the side, they look super thin! 📺
hint: It looks like a straight line.

question: Which view of a shoe shows the shoelaces the best? 👟
explanation: Super! Looking from the top lets you clearly see and tie your shoelaces! 👟
hint: Look down at your feet.

question: You are picking a book from a bookshelf. What view is this? 📚
explanation: Great job! Standing in front of the shelf gives you the front view of all the books! 📚
hint: You are facing it directly.

question: Which view shows the round wheels of a school bus perfectly? 🚌
explanation: Awesome! To see the completely round wheels, you must look from the side! 🚌
hint: Look from the long part of the bus.

question: Look at a soup can (cylinder) from the very top. What do you see? 🥫
explanation: Wonderful! The top lid of a cylinder-shaped can is a perfect circle! 🥫
hint: Look at the lid.

question: Your friend is hiding in the closet with the door closed. Where are they? 🚪
explanation: Super! Hiding in a closet means you are inside it! 🚪
hint: They are within the walls of the closet.

question: How does a star shape look when viewed from the front? ⭐
explanation: Great job! A flat star shape always looks like a beautiful star! ⭐
hint: It keeps its pointy shape.

question: A map has symbols. What does a red plus sign (+) usually mean? 🏥
explanation: Awesome! A plus sign (+) on a map is the symbol for a hospital or clinic! 🏥
hint: It is a place where doctors work.

question: You look down from your bed at a sleeping dog on the rug. What view is this? 🐕
explanation: Super! Looking down from a high place always gives you a top view! 🛏️
hint: You are looking from above.

question: If you stand right in front of a car, what part do you clearly see? 🚗
explanation: Great job! From the front, you can clearly see the headlights shining bright! 🚗
hint: They light up the road ahead.

question: What shape is the screen of a mobile phone from the front? 📱
explanation: Awesome! Phone screens have long, straight sides making them rectangles! 📱
hint: It is taller than it is wide.

question: If you look at an egg lying on a table from the side, what shape is it? 🥚
explanation: Wonderful! An egg is slightly stretched, making it a beautiful oval shape! 🥚
hint: It is like a stretched circle.

question: Where is the sun at noon time when your shadow is very short? ☀️
explanation: Super! At noon, the bright sun is right above your head! ☀️
hint: Look straight up into the sky.

question: Which view of an open laptop shows the screen clearly? 💻
explanation: Great job! You must sit in the front view to read the laptop screen! 💻
hint: You face it to work.

question: If you look straight down at a party hat (cone) from the top, what do you see? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! The round base of the cone makes it look like a circle from the top! 🎉
hint: Look at the very bottom ring.

question: If you look at a party hat (cone) from the side, what shape is it? 🎈
explanation: Super! From the side, the pointy top and flat bottom look just like a triangle! 🔺
hint: It has three pointy corners.

question: If a park is very near your house, how long does it take to get there? 🏞️
explanation: Great job! 'Near' means the distance is short, so you get there quickly! 🏃
hint: It is just around the corner.

question: If your friend's house is far away, the distance is what? 🏠
explanation: Awesome! 'Far' means there is a very long distance between two places! 🗺️
hint: You might need a car or bus.

question: How does a flat frying pan look from the top view? 🍳
explanation: Wonderful! The cooking part of a pan is a big, perfect circle! 🍳
hint: It is round like a plate.

question: On a map, what does a big patch of blue color usually show? 💧
explanation: Super! Maps use beautiful blue color to show rivers, lakes, and oceans! 🌊
hint: Fish swim in it.

question: If you look down at an open door from the ceiling, what does it look like? 🚪
explanation: Great job! A door is very thin, so from the very top, it just looks like a line! 🚪
hint: It has almost no thickness.

question: The top view of a very tall square building looks like what? 🏢
explanation: Awesome! From an airplane, a tall building just looks like a flat square shape! ✈️
hint: You cannot see its height from the top.

question: You are lying in bed looking at the ceiling fan. What view is this? 🪭
explanation: Super! Looking straight up at something above you gives you the bottom view! 🛏️
hint: You are looking from underneath.

question: Looking at a railway track from a bridge above, what do you see? 🛤️
explanation: Great job! The long tracks look like two straight lines running together! 🛤️
hint: They go side by side.

question: Which arrow tells you to go straight ahead? ⬆️
explanation: Awesome! The upward pointing arrow means to keep moving straight ahead safely! 🚶
hint: It points right in front of you.
